 Hon'Ble Arindam Sinha, J. 
Hon'Ble Satya Veer Singh, J.
1.

With reference to our earlier order dated 6th November, 2025, Mr. Nayab Ahmad Khan, learned advocate appearing on behalf of respondent no.2 (Executive Officer, the Nagar Palika Parishad)
hands up writing dated 10th November, 2025 with copy to Mr. Rizwan Ahmad (Qureshi), learned advocate appearing on behalf of petitioner.

He submits, petitioner's representation dated 11th July,
2025 seeking issuance of 'No Objection Certificate' for obtaining central license from Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, to enable him to run his meat shop, has been rejected.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text:
Dr. D.K.
Tiwari, learned advocate, Additional Chief Standing Counsel appears on behalf of State.
2. Petitioner is now in possession of rejection order dated 10th November, 2025.
He has to act as per advice he may obtain.
3. The writ petition is disposed of.
